caption_L1: This is a bar graph called Number of branches of National Central Banks providing euro currency cash services in the eurozone as of December 2019 , by country. The y-axis shows Number of NCB branches while the x-axis shows Country.
caption_L2L3: At the time of data collection, the countries most favourably using the euro in NCB were France, Germany and Italy at over 35 each. Spain and Greece were moderate users with between 10 and 20, while all other countries plotted at less than 10 branches each.
